No fatal defects missed by the earlier readings were found. The proof is valid for the standard Cantor cube (product of discrete two‑point spaces).  The only potential imprecision — that the Statement does not explicitly say that **2** carries the discrete topology — is standard mathematical convention and does not affect the logical soundness of the proof under that universal reading; a competent reader supplies the intended topology without pause.  Hence no fatal defect is present.
